extracted.intended_audience: successful ESO proposal Principal Investigators and awarded observers (Visitor, Designated Visitor, Service Mode, and APEX users)
extracted.subtask_description: Official ESO guidance for Principal Investigators who have been allocated observing time, covering visitor/designated-visitor/service modes, Phase 2 requirements, scheduling, data access, and publication/press-release policies. Advises required actions, deadlines, and contacts to ensure observations proceed and data/publication rules are followed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obligations of successful ESO Principal Investigators
rubrics_metrics.description: As a successful ESO Principal Investigator you are bound to the general conditions stated in the Call for Proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Read Instructions for Visiting Astronomers and Notes for Observers
rubrics_metrics.description: Please read the following important information carefully: Instructions for Visiting Astronomers (note the specific information for La Silla) and Notes for Observers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make your travel arrangements as soon as possible! Any failure to comply with the Instructions for Visiting Astronomers may result in the cancellation of the programme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify and check allocation dates and scheduled windows
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are unsure about the allocation dates, consult the online schedule query form providing your programme ID (e.g. 23DP) in the Run/Programme ID field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NEW as of P113: a graphical display of the telescope schedules is available. Please check that the scheduled windows are suited to the required constraints and target coordinates. In case of problems with allocated dates, immediately contact the Observing Programmes Office via the ESO Ticketing System.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designated Visitor Mode (DVM) — remote presence & preparation timing
rubrics_metrics.description: If your run has been allocated time in Designated Visitor Mode (DVM), the observations will be carried out by ESO staff during pre-allocated time slots, during which you are expected to be in remote contact with the mountain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare the relevant observing material at least 10 days before the run to allow enough time for a verification iteration with the User Support Department ensuring smooth operations. Follow the specific instructions provided for Paranal and La Silla at the listed URLs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designated Visitor Mode — operational procedure and contact for problems
rubrics_metrics.description: For DVM runs, ensure scheduled windows are suited to constraints and target coordinates; be available for remote contact during pre-allocated slots.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In case of problems, get immediately in touch with the Observing Programmes Office via the ESO Ticketing System. For efficient processing, select 'OPO-Observing Programmes Office' in the department field of the submission form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service Mode — Phase 2 submission required
rubrics_metrics.description: A Phase 2 package needs to be submitted for each approved run in Service Mode.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please check the Phase 2 submission deadline. Users having obtained time in Service Mode with the VLT must read carefully the Service Mode Guidelines. APEX users should refer to the APEX Phase 2 submission page.

rubrics_metrics.name: APEX registration and contact details accuracy
rubrics_metrics.description: To register APEX runs, users should make sure to enter their e-mail addresses exactly as stored in the ESO User Portal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Late submission penalties for Phase 2 material
rubrics_metrics.description: Late submission penalties apply: if Phase 2 material is submitted late without the express permission of ESO, your Priority Category will be reduced.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific demotions: A to B, B to C, C to rejected.

rubrics_metrics.name: User support and help resources
rubrics_metrics.description: If requiring assistance with Phase 2 preparations or other issues, contact the User Support Department through the ESO Operations Helpdesk and check the Knowledgebase for frequently asked questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to check allocation details
rubrics_metrics.description: You can check the details of your allocation using the schedule query form by entering the programme ID (e.g. 23NP) in the Run/Programme ID field and pushing Search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NEW as of P113: a graphical display of the telescope schedules is available at the provided link.

rubrics_metrics.name: ESO Science Archive Facility is sole access point for data
rubrics_metrics.description: The ESO Science Archive Facility is the sole access point to data obtained with ESO telescopes. This includes access to proprietary data for both Visitor and Service Mode runs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data availability timing and calibration association
rubrics_metrics.description: Typically, the files become available from the Science Archive Facility at archive.eso.org within few hours from the observation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Archive Calibration Selector service allows to associate calibrations and ancillary files to raw science files for further processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proprietary period start and immutability
rubrics_metrics.description: As of 1 April 2013, the proprietary period for all science and acquisition files runs from the moment the file can be accessed and downloaded from the Archive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This means the 'proprietary period' will begin on the date the file is accessible; no PI or PI delegate action will affect the proprietary period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication acknowledgement requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Any publication based on observations collected at the La Silla Paranal Observatory must mention in a footnote on the first page: 'Based on observations collected at the European Southern Observatory, Chile', with indication of the programme number(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For more details, consult ESO publication policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press-release contact requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Should you believe that your results are worthy of a press release ESO asks you to contact the ESO Education and Public Outreach Department (information@eso.org) before the publication of the paper.
